title: HARBOR WORKS — Beach Commons V12
dek: A marina should not only store boats. It should teach a city how to keep things afloat.
body:
HARBOR WORKS imagines a marina as a working civic atelier: vessel triage, repair education, a coastal parts counter, clean-bilge service, adaptive small-craft access, industrial archaeology, marine electronics, art, and a sunset table where useful work becomes public contentment.

Eight original architectural plates form the study. The Useful Marina makes the complete metabolism visible. The Five-Future Triage Hall asks whether a vessel should keep sailing, become a bounded repair lesson, join a shared fleet, yield inspected parts, or enter licensed dismantling. The Hull Library gives safe components provenance. The Clean Bilge Lab makes no-discharge service beautiful. The Public Launch Commons makes small craft easier to share. A decontaminated Workboat Cutaway moves industrial archaeology onto land. Harbor Radio turns safe signal practice and low-voltage electronics into night culture. The Contentment Pier ends with mending, tea, drawing, stories, quiet sound, packed tools, and open access.

The human edition includes One Boat, Five Futures, a browser-local educational sorter. Ownership and hazards are gates before structure, public usefulness, and component value can produce a future. Unknown title returns Resolve Ownership. Unknown hazards return Contain and Survey. Nothing is stored or sent, and no real vessel is assessed.

The originating X post describes marina-wide languishing, undeveloped land, a fire-damaged yacht-club building, and an abandoned-boat epidemic. PointCast treats that description as a creative provocation, not a verified inventory. Current LA County material describes active capital work and more than 4,600 slips across 23 marinas. County material also confirms serious December 2023 fire damage to the former California Yacht Club clubhouse and a later licensing path for the adjacent former Tony P's site.

No boat, slip, parcel, lease, building, waste stream, title, lien, hazard condition, owner authorization, land availability, project approval, permit, partner, funding source, acquisition drive, salvage call, public launch, or event is claimed. Major repair, fabrication, dismantling, fluid removal, painting, grinding, and material processing belong in authorized contained landside facilities. Navigation, five-knot operation, no discharge, working slips, public paths, emergency access, habitat, qualified hazardous-material handling, and current coastal and harbor rules govern.

media.alt: A sunset marina combines an authorized repair yard, orange gantry, sailcloth shade, small-craft launch, shared worktables, and calm public seating.
